consumer: An engine possession/eligibility check asking 'does the avatar carry a working multitool?' (a has-item/has-charges predicate over the avatar's on-person inventory, as a condition/dialogue would call it).
scope: The avatar's on-person carried inventory (wielded/worn/held), evaluated as a functional 'working' predicate, not raw item rows.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items dumps raw wielded/worn/inv_const_slice item fields (type_id, charges, count_by_charges) as JSON, exposing simulation state and forcing the consumer to re-derive possession.
divergence: A depleted multitool (charges==0) sitting in inventory: write_carried_items still emits it so a naive reader counts it as carried/working, while the engine's working-tool possession predicate returns false.
